audit.why: 57.36% over 1379 games supports FAV / 4/10. Quinn owns the early poke lane; Garen only threatens once he lands Decisive Strike into Judgment.
audit.corrected: Left the difficulty framing; sharpened what actually decides the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet level chart (Quinn, Skill, Garen, Garen, Skill, Garen, Skill) contradicts both stored layers, which read Quinn on five of seven rows, and contradicts a 57.36% win rate.
audit.why: The mirror (garen__quinn) hit the same conflict and deliberately left the chart alone rather than guess which authority governs. Editing one side here would create a mirror disagreement.
audit.corrected: No chart edit. Raised as a question instead. Spike text corrected with real numbers: Courage 22s at rank 1, Decisive Strike 8s, Judgment 9s at rank 1, Blinding Assault 11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings tell you to 'blind his spin' or 'Blind (E) his Q-E'. Blinding Assault is a Q, not an E, and it does nothing to Judgment, which is not an attack.
audit.why: Riot's Judgment text is a spin dealing physical damage in an area — no basic attack involved, so nothing Blinding Assault does touches it. Garen's burst tell is the Decisive Strike auto reset, which is the attack worth denying. Courage also grants tenacity by Riot's own text, so the Vault slow is cut short during it.
audit.corrected: Pointed the denial at Decisive Strike, stated plainly that Judgment is unaffected, and named Courage's tenacity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Demacian Justice ignores resistances.
audit.why: R carries trueDamage and execute flags — buying armour does not raise the threshold you must stay above.
audit.corrected: Added to the Critical Don'ts line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Common Mistakes list repeated the wrong blind advice.
audit.corrected: Replaced the don't with staying above the execute threshold.

edits.before: Garen is exactly the slow, melee, auto-reliant juggernaut you farm on. At level 1 your range and Harrier reset chunk him every time he walks up to CS, and he has no answer. Your Q blind isn't huge here since his burst is his empowered auto (Q), but the moment you blind that strike his trade evaporates. Bait his Q silence with your E dash, refresh Harrier on the way out, and never sit in his W damage-cut window.
edits.after: Garen is exactly the slow, melee, auto-reliant juggernaut you farm on. At level 1 your range and Harrier reset chunk him every time he walks up to CS, and he has no answer. Blinding Assault hinders his vision and denies the Decisive Strike auto, but it does nothing to Judgment — poke, then leave his 325 spin range. Bait the 8s silence with Vault and never trade into Courage.
